theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : Nat.gcd (2 * n + 1) (n + 1) = 1 := by
  let d := Nat.gcd (2 * n + 1) (n + 1)
  have h : d ∣ 2 * n + 1 := by exact dvd_gcd_left
  have k : d ∣ n + 1 := by exact dvd_gcd_right
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := k
  have h1 : d ∣ 2 * n + 1 - 2 * (n + 1) := by exact dvd_sub ha (dvd_mul_right d 2)
  simp [h1] at ha
  have h2 : d ∣ -1 := by exact dvd_sub ha (dvd_mul_right d 2)
  have h3 : d ∣ 1 := by exact dvd_neg h2
  exact eq_of_dvd_one h3
